subject: Next steps: procurement readiness & marketplace route for Quantifai
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Graves <alex.graves@quantifai.com>, procurement_ops@quantifai.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: procurement readiness & marketplace route for Quantifai

Hi Alex / Quantifai procurement team —

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we can align on the procurement path (AWS Marketplace vs PO/card):

Key items we discussed:
- Marketplace interest: you indicated a preference for AWS Marketplace if we can support a Private Offer and map billing to your existing marketplace account.
- PO vs card: finance prefers PO for contracts >$50k/year but desktop teams can pilot on card to start faster.
- Legal & security: Quantifai requested SOC 2 report, standard DPA, and an outline of data residency options.

Open questions / asks (what we need from you):
1) Please confirm the preferred procurement lane (Marketplace Private Offer vs PO via AP) and who the procurement owner is (name + email).
2) If Marketplace: can you share the AWS marketplace account ID to map offers?
3) If PO: do you have a preferred PO template or any special billing cadence requirements?

Proposed Redwood deliverables:
- Provide SOC 2 summary and DPA by EOD Oct 4.
- Send a sample Private Offer flow + checklist (what procurement needs to approve) — attached draft.
- If Marketplace onboarding will take >2 weeks, offer an interim 90-day pilot on card to avoid blocking product timelines.

Attachments: Quantifai_RFP_Q3.pdf (RFP notes we took), OrderForm_Draft.docx (sample order form).

Next steps: can procurement_ops@quantifai.com confirm the buy route and account ID by end of week (Oct 7)? If yes, Ben and I will put together the Private Offer paperwork and sequence the legal review.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick follow if helpful.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0126

From: Alex Graves <alex.graves@quantifai.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement_ops@quantifai.com
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement readiness & marketplace route for Quantifai

Hi Neha —

Really helpful recap, thanks. A few quick items from our side:

- We do prefer AWS Marketplace if we can get a Private Offer and standard SaaS contract terms. That makes procurement sign-off much faster for us.
- Procurement owner is Priya Singh (procurement_ops@quantifai.com) — I've looped her in.
- On invoicing: can Redwood support monthly invoicing to our marketplace account and link invoices to our purchase orders? Also want to confirm whether Marketplace Private Offer supports net-30 invoicing or if finance requires a PO routed outside the marketplace.

Can you send the SOC 2 and a sample Private Offer flow (who signs what and expected timeline)? Also send a sample PO template if possible — our finance team likes to see a template ahead of approvals.

If Marketplace can't be live within two weeks, we'll consider the 90-day card pilot but will need a short MSA addendum for pilot data handling.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Graves
Head of Platform Engineering | Quantifai
alex.graves@quantifai.com | +1 (646) 555-0199

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Next steps: procurement readiness & marketplace route for Quantifai

Neha / Marissa — quick internal note on recommended approach before we reply to Quantifai: 

1) Recommend Marketplace Private Offer as primary path — lowers procurement friction long term and keeps billing tied to their AWS account. We should confirm whether they need net-30 via marketplace or outside-of-marketplace PO mapping (this is the main blocker for finance).
2) Prepare: a short "Marketplace Private Offer checklist" for procurement (what AWS IDs we need, expected signatures, timeline). I attached an internal draft.
3) Pricing cadence: propose holding current quoted rates for 30 days while procurement validates the route.
4) Contingency: offer a 90-day pilot on card with a limited token cap and an addendum that preserves data handling terms; this unblocks engineering while procurement completes setup.

Action: Neha — include the internal checklist and SOC2 summary in your next email, and offer the pilot language as a fallback. I can follow up with finance if Priya asks about PO mapping or invoicing cadence.

Attachment: Marketplace_Private_Offer_Steps.pdf

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Graves <alex.graves@quantifai.com>, procurement_ops@quantifai.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 10:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: procurement readiness & marketplace route for Quantifai

Alex / Priya — thanks for the quick reply and for looping procurement in. Consolidating next steps and a proposed timeline so we all have alignment: 

1) By Oct 4: Redwood will send SOC 2 summary, DPA, and the Private Offer checklist (what we need from Quantifai to create a Private Offer).
2) By Oct 7: Quantifai procurement confirms preferred lane and (if Marketplace) provides AWS marketplace account ID and confirmation of invoicing requirements (net-30 via marketplace vs external PO).
3) If Marketplace is greenlit: Redwood will begin Private Offer creation (expect 5–10 business days for offer paperwork and legal review).
4) Contingency path: if Marketplace onboarding goes beyond Oct 15, we will set up a 90-day pilot on card with a simple addendum for data handling and pilot limits (we'll share language).

Attachments: Quantifai_RFP_Q3.pdf, OrderForm_Draft.docx (both included here for procurement's reference).

Please confirm procurement owner (Priya, please confirm) and the AWS account ID if you want us to proceed with Private Offer mapping. If helpful, we can schedule a 15-minute call next week between Redwood finance and Quantifai procurement to clarify invoicing details.

Thanks — looking forward to your confirmation.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0126
